findings.rule: REVIEW.md Framework rules: Flag when the change has made CLAUDE.md outdated
findings.summary: The diff makes CLAUDE.md outdated: lines 5-6 still describe Binance spot/USD-M klines from Binance Vision, line 30 lists the deleted `vision` module, and lines 36-37 name the deleted tests/binance_stub.py and tests/fixtures/binance/; plan.md names the replacement lines for the owner's follow-up PR, but until that lands the guardrail file misdescribes the package.

cache_info validates --interval against the spot market regardless of --market, so `cache-info --market futures --interval 6h` is accepted (and lists nothing) instead of being refused like the other futures-only checks.

Doubtful, unverifiable offline: on the current day the futures loop asks one more window starting after the in-progress candle; if KuCoin answers a future `from` with the latest (older) row instead of an empty list, the 'rows but none that moves the window' rule turns it into UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE, so every load that includes today raises KlineGapError for today (plan Risks covers only a refusal, not this answer shape).
